heroHeadline: Day 797: Predawn Montesierra Attack Kills Two as Federal Offensive Nets 21 Cartel Detentions Around Mazatlán
heroSubtitle: 797 days of cartel civil war: in the early hours of September 27, gunmen attacked three men gathered for drinks in Culiacán's Ampliación Montesierra sector, killing two and wounding a third, while reporting the same day tallied a week-long federal, state and Navy offensive (September 19-25) that detained 21 people around Mazatlán, including named Chapitos and Mayiza operatives, and seized a 49-tonne precursor-chemical cache at El Diez. It follows a violent September 25-26 stretch: gunmen killed three men inside a home in Culiacán's Urbi Villas del Sol subdivision, a motorcyclist was killed and his companion wounded in Mazatlán's Colinas del Real, a wave of five further Mazatlán attacks wounded three more people, federal forces detained eight people in Mazatlán-area operations seizing explosives and fentanyl, a rehab center and two other Culiacán properties were shot up wounding a Chinese national, a second man was found shot dead in Villas del Humaya, and the Mexican Navy killed an armed suspect near El Recodo, Mazatlán. Days of open civil war: 797+.
